requirements:
Build an online food delivery platform where users can register and login, browse restaurants, view menus, add food items to their cart, place orders, make online payments and track deliveries.

Restaurant administrators should manage restaurants, menus, food items and incoming orders.

Delivery partners should view assigned deliveries and update delivery status.

The system should provide secure authentication, fast response times, reliable data storage and a responsive web interface.

Build a hospital management system where patients can register, book appointments with doctors and view their medical history.

Doctors should manage their appointment schedules, record diagnoses and write prescriptions for patients.

Administrators should manage departments, doctors and patient billing.

The system should keep patient data secure, respond quickly and be available at all times.

Build an online library management system where members can search the catalogue, borrow books, return books and renew loans.

Librarians should manage books, members and loans, and collect fines for overdue books.

The system should send email reminders before the due date.

It should be easy to use, secure and reliable.

Build an e-commerce platform where customers can browse a product catalogue, add products to a cart, pay online and track their orders.

Sellers should list products and manage their inventory after being approved by administrators.

Administrators should approve sellers and handle refund requests.

The platform should be secure, scalable and fast.

Build an online examination platform where students can take timed tests and view their results.

Teachers should create question banks, schedule exams and review auto-graded results on a dashboard.

Administrators should manage users and exam settings.

The system should be secure against cheating, reliable during exams and responsive.
